ideas.title: The Impact of the DOJ Investigation on Minnesota Politics
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential consequences of the DOJ's investigation into Walz and Frey on Minnesota politics and the upcoming elections.
ideas.angle: The political fallout of the investigation
questions: How will the investigation affect the 2026 elections?
What are the potential consequences for Walz and Frey's careers?
ideas.insight: The investigation could have significant implications for Minnesota politics and the careers of Walz and Frey.
